facts.fact: Belém Tower stands by the Tagus and is a UNESCO World Heritage monument.
The tower was designed by Francisco de Arruda and includes a bastion projecting towards the river.
Its decoration includes the royal coat of arms, an armillary sphere and the cross of the Order of Christ.
